top_story.headline: Rep. Dan Crenshaw still has no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 84 days past his final extension
top_story.dek: The House filing index shows an extension filed June 4 and a final extension date of August 13, 2026.
paragraphs: Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) is the one sitting member the Deadline Watch check found with no calendar-year 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, past every extension. He filed an extension on June 4, 2026, and the final extension date of August 13, 2026 passed 84 days ago.

The check compares every sitting member against the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD. The Senate half failed to run today, so this result covers the House only. A filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can also read as missing, so the finding rests on the index search.

Separately, the Ethics Agreement Tracker lists 7 confirmed officials with no posted certification of ethics-agreement compliance more than 30 days past deadline. The longest is Michelle White Bowman, Governor and Vice Chairman for Supervision of the Federal Reserve System Board of Governors, confirmed June 4, 2025, with certification due September 2, 2025 (429 days ago).

sections.headline: Attorney General Todd Blanche Obtains Certificate of Divestiture
paragraphs: Four executive branch ethics documents were processed by the U.S. Office of Government Ethics, including a Certificate of Divestiture and three compliance certifications across three executive departments.

items: Todd Blanche, Attorney General, Department of Justice — Certificate of Divestiture (OGE-2026-183) (document request form). Only the fact of the divestiture is confirmed, not the asset.
Jonathan Gould, Comptroller of the Currency, Department of the Treasury — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance confirming full divestment from the AIP Alternative Lending Fund A.
Sriprakash Kothari, Assistant Secretary for Economic Policy, Department of the Treasury — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance confirming completion of required divestitures.
Donald A. Blome, Assistant Secretary for Near Eastern Affairs, Department of State — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance.

sections.headline: One new one-person registrant for a Canadian advisory firm; three Clock Tower X filings carry Hegseth headlines
paragraphs: DOJ's FARA files show one new registrant today. No terminations or changes to existing foreign principals appear in the input.

items: Victor Vernick (#7792) registered on November 4, 2026 with one foreign principal, RRico Corporate Development Company of Vancouver, British Columbia (Canada). His registration statement lists his occupation as Government Affairs Representative and his primary address as 1763 Columbia Rd NW, Ste 175, Washington, DC. Registrant record, Registration Statement.

Victor Vernick's Exhibit AB for RRico Corporate Development Company: the foreign principal is a corporation, and the form describes its business as "strategic reviews, business structuring, corporate growth, and advisory services for various enterprises." It answers "No" to every question on foreign government supervision, ownership, direction, control, financing or subsidy, and states that Ronald Rieder is the sole proprietor. The OCR excerpt does not show the agreement's terms, dates or fees. Exhibit AB.

blocks.text: Other filed documents: informational materials from Geopolitical Solutions LLC (#7770) for the Republic of Yemen, stamped 11/03/2026 (filing); a supplemental statement from the Hong Kong Tourism Board (#2110), stamped 11/04/2026 (filing); and three informational-materials filings from Clock Tower X LLC (#7649) for the State of Israel via Havas Media Germany GmbH, stamped 2026-10-22 (one, two, three). The Clock Tower X filings reproduce Breaking Defense articles about Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth at the AUSA conference. They name him only in headlines and record no communication with him.

sections.headline: No new House or Senate disclosures in the input
paragraphs: The input held no House or Senate financial disclosures filed since November 2 that an earlier edition had not already reported. The Senate eFD fetch failed with a parsing error, so the Senate side was not verified today.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
